rows.quote: We gathered the genome wide association study (GWAS) data of BC from BCAC (OncoArray, n = 138,508) and BCAC (iCOGS, n = 76,167).
rows.coder_note: The sentence names two array-specific BCAC GWAS (OncoArray n 138,508; iCOGS n 76,167), and a later sentence a BCAC OncoArray survival set (n 91,686). Every BCAC dictionary row is a combined analysis (Michailidou 2017: 122,977 cases and 105,974 controls; Zhang 2020 rows), and none has these arms or these N, so the named datasets have no row. No citation or year is given that would tie the arms to one BCAC publication.
'The FinnGen study (n = 224,737)' with no release number; 224,737 equals no FinnGen release N (R5 218,792; R6 260,405), and a count with a cohort name alone does not identify a release (rules D, I1).

rows.quote: Methods We collected the protein quantitative trait locus (pQTL) data of 4,907 circulating proteins from the DeCODE study (n = 35,559) as exposures.
rows.coder_note: deCODE with exact N 35,559 and the 4,907-protein panel: the release N and panel of Ferkingstad 2021; the Eldjarn 2023 deCODE row has the same panel but N 35,892, so only this row matches.
